title: Accessibility Assistant — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Supports text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and accessible formatting. The Accessibility Assistant supports text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and accessible formatting. It reads course material aloud with natural pacing, transcribes spoken answers into text, and reformats documents — larger type, better contrast, clear headings — for readable access. Every student gets the material in the form that works for them.

demo.title: Worked example end to end
demo.code: let level=3;const answers=[true,true,true,false,true];let correct=0;for(const a of answers){if(a){correct++;if(correct>=3){level++;correct=0}}else{correct=0}}J({finalLevel:level});assert(level===4,'adaptive');
